name: worldmonitor-custom
description: Independent Tactical World Monitor — Direct Keyless Upstream Intelligence, Markets, Polymarket & Vietnam/East Sea Focus

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,emerald "tsx watch server/index.ts" "vite --config client/vite.config.ts"
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build --config client/vite.config.ts && node --input-type=module -e "import { build } from 'esbuild'; await build({ entryPoints: ['server/index.ts'], bundle: true, platform: 'node', format: 'esm', packages: 'external', outfile: 'dist/server/index.js' })"
